title: A category matrix that had no rules gets the General Matrix's rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a category matrix with no rules (matrix A) for one category (category A), and write down the default matrix's ranges and markups.
  • Use the same client after the deploy, with no matrix changed since.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Change the Default value of the first range of matrix A to a different value.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open the General Matrix from the Matrices list.
  7. Click matrix A on the Matrices list again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed with category A.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's Default column has the same ranges and markups as written down for the default matrix.

Step 3:

  • Every cell of matrix A can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The edit bar counts 1 change.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A saves without a question and shows the new value.

Step 6:

  • The General Matrix still shows the written-down ranges and markups.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A shows its own changed first range value, different from the General Matrix's first range.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
